title: Bloom Ladder Blocks
description: Canonical Bloom-ladder rung table: one rung per Bloom's Revised Taxonomy cognitive level, each declaring the Courseforge BLOCK_TYPES subset permitted at that rung plus the rung's misconception-card probe-authoring guidance. Source of truth for the Bloom-ladder loader (`lib/ontology/bloom_ladder.py`) consumed by the block planner / content-generation ladder-capping logic (ED4ALL_BLOOM_LADDER). The schema is dual-use: it both describes the shape (via $defs) and carries the data itself as the `default` value on each level property, so loaders can read the defaults directly (mirrors `schemas/taxonomies/bloom_verbs.json`).
$comment: block_types values are drawn ONLY from the existing 30-member Courseforge/scripts/blocks.py::BLOCK_TYPES frozenset (mirrored for import-light validation by lib/generation/block_catalog.py) -- no new BLOCK_TYPES tokens are minted here. misconception_probe.card_class / claim_class / correction_class are pinned VERBATIM to the existing misconception-card / misconception-claim / misconception-correction HTML class-token contract read by Trainforge/generators/synthesis_window_contract.py:222-238 -- zero-touch, additive guidance only.

ProbeStrategy.description: The misconception-authoring pattern the rung's misconception-card should probe with. One canonical strategy per rung.

MisconceptionProbe.description: Per-rung misconception-card probe guidance. card_class / claim_class / correction_class are the existing (zero-touch) HTML class tokens the rewrite tier already emits -- see Courseforge/generators/_rewrite_provider.py and Trainforge/generators/synthesis_window_contract.py:222-238.

RungEntry.description: One Bloom-ladder rung: its ordinal position, the block_types permitted at this rung, and its misconception-card probe guidance.

ordinal.description: 1-indexed rung position, low (remember=1) to high (create=6) cognitive complexity.

block_types.description: Courseforge BLOCK_TYPES tokens permitted at this rung. Non-empty, deduplicated, drawn only from the canonical 30-member palette.

remember.description: Rung 1 -- Remember. Recall / recognition-oriented block types; misconception probes as a flat wrong-fact negation.

understand.description: Rung 2 -- Understand. Explanation / paraphrase-oriented block types; misconception probes as a claim that is right in part and wrong in part.

apply.description: Rung 3 -- Apply. Procedure / worked-practice block types; misconception probes as a procedural step-order slip.

analyze.description: Rung 4 -- Analyze. Decomposition / relationship block types; misconception probes as a swapped cause-and-effect direction.

evaluate.description: Rung 5 -- Evaluate. Judgment / critique block types; misconception probes as an invalid comparison to a superficially-similar case.

create.description: Rung 6 -- Create. Synthesis / production block types; misconception probes as a rule over-generalized past its valid domain.
